title: Philips Norelco OneBlade 360 Blades, Genuine Replacement Blades for OneBlade Electric Shaver and Trimmer, Durable Stainless Steel, Trim, Edge and Shave, 3 Pack, QP430/80

reviews.title: Genuine blades that work perfectly
reviews.body: I’ve been using these replacement blades for my Philips OneBlade and I’m very happy with them. They fit perfectly and are very easy to replace, which makes maintenance simple.The shave is smooth and comfortable, and the blades feel sharp without being harsh on the skin. I also like that they last quite a while with regular use, so I don’t have to change them too often.They handle trimming, edging, and shaving well, just like the original ones that came with the device. Overall, they keep my OneBlade working like new.Very satisfied with this purchase and I would definitely buy them again.

reviews.title: Far better than the imitation blades.
reviews.body: I have tried other low cost replacements, and they are definitely as cheap as the price is. They snag and wear out so quickly compared to these original replacement heads. Do not be cheap and try to cut cost when the originals do far better, last longer, and provide far more value for the price. I've tried several others and they don't even come close to these. Yes, they are more expensive, but they're smoother, more durable, and overall, work much better than the imitation.

reviews.title: Long Lasting Replacement Heads That Work Well
reviews.body: These replacement blades have lasted much longer than I expected. They are more expensive than some other replacement heads, but the quality has been worth it for me. I use the OneBlade for my bikini line and it gives a smooth trim without irritation, bumps, or razor burn. The device itself works really well and these replacement heads keep it performing like new.

reviews.title: Great Shave but Blades Don’t Last as Long as They Used To
reviews.body: These Philips Norelco OneBlade replacement blades work well and give a really clean, comfortable shave. The OneBlade system itself is great and these genuine replacement blades fit perfectly and perform as expected.That said, I do feel like the durability has gone down a bit over time. In my experience, the blades don’t seem to last quite as long as they used to.Because of that, it’s a good idea to keep a few extras on hand or set them up on a subscription so you don’t run out when one starts getting dull. Overall, they still work great, but you may find yourself replacing them a bit more often.
